note: Numbers and enums only; notes are our own words. Every other SRD spell is listed in uncurated.

mech.name: Chill Touch
notes: The target can’t regain hit points until the start of the caster’s next turn.

mech.name: Sorcerous Burst
notes: Each d8 that rolls an 8 adds another d8, up to the spellcasting modifier.

mech.name: Starry Wisp
notes: The target sheds light and can’t benefit from being invisible until the end of the caster’s next turn.

mech.name: Vicious Mockery
notes: Disadvantage on its next attack roll before the end of its next turn.

mech.name: Charm Person
notes: Advantage on the save if the caster or its allies are fighting it.

mech.name: Chromatic Orb
notes: Matching dice let it leap to another target.

mech.name: Command
notes: The target follows a one-word command on its next turn.

mech.name: Divine Favor
notes: Its weapon hits deal an extra 1d4 radiant damage.

mech.name: Divine Smite
notes: Extra damage on a melee weapon hit; +1d8 against fiends and undead.

mech.name: Entangle
notes: A STR check against the DC frees it. Difficult terrain.

mech.name: Faerie Fire
notes: Outlined targets cannot benefit from being invisible.

mech.name: Find Familiar
notes: Opens Add creature, controlled by the caster.

mech.name: Guiding Bolt
notes: The next attack against the target before the end of the caster’s next turn has advantage.

mech.name: Healing Word
notes: No effect on undead or constructs.

mech.name: Hellish Rebuke
notes: Cast in reaction to being damaged by a creature it can see.

mech.name: Heroism
notes: Immune to frightened; the temporary hit points come back at the start of each of its turns.

mech.name: Ice Knife
notes: Hit or miss, each creature within 5 feet of the target makes a DEX save or takes 2d6 cold (+1d6 per slot level above 1).

mech.name: Mage Armor
notes: Only on a creature wearing no armor; ends if it dons armor.

mech.name: Magic Missile
notes: One dart per target here; darts can be split among targets as the caster likes (three, plus one per slot level above 1).

mech.name: Protection from Evil and Good
notes: Aberrations, celestials, elementals, fey, fiends and undead have disadvantage to attack it; it cannot be charmed, frightened or possessed by them.

mech.name: Ray of Sickness
notes: Poisoned until the end of the caster’s next turn.

mech.name: Searing Smite
notes: Extra damage on a weapon hit; the target burns for 1d6 fire each turn until a CON save ends it.

mech.name: Shield
notes: Counts against the triggering attack.
No damage from Magic Missile while it lasts.

mech.name: Sleep
notes: Incapacitated until the end of its next turn, then unconscious if it fails a second save; ends on damage.

mech.name: Thunderwave
notes: On a failed save the target is pushed 10 feet away.

mech.name: Blindness/Deafness
notes: Or deafened instead, chosen when cast.

mech.name: Find Steed
notes: Opens Add creature, controlled by the caster.

mech.name: Invisibility
notes: Ends on the target after it attacks, deals damage or casts a spell.

mech.name: Mind Spike
notes: The caster knows where the target is while the spell lasts.

mech.name: Shining Smite
notes: Extra damage on a weapon hit; the target sheds light and can’t benefit from being invisible.

mech.name: Spiritual Weapon
notes: Bonus action: melee spell attack for 1d8 + modifier force damage (more with a higher slot).

mech.name: Web
notes: A STR check (2014) or DEX check (2024) against the DC frees it. Difficult terrain.

mech.name: Animate Dead
notes: Opens Add creature, controlled by the caster.

mech.name: Conjure Animals
notes: A pack of spectral animals, not creatures: nothing to add to the initiative.

on_land.question: The caster makes a CON save against your DC. Countered on a failure; its slot isn't spent.

mech.name: Dispel Magic
notes: Higher-level effects need a spellcasting ability check against 10 + their level.

mech.name: Fear
notes: Drops what it holds and must Dash away; it repeats the save only when it ends its turn out of the caster’s sight.

mech.name: Fireball
notes: Ignites unattended flammable objects.

mech.name: Haste
notes: One extra limited action each turn.

mech.name: Hypnotic Pattern
notes: Its speed is 0; another creature can use an action to shake it free.

mech.name: Mass Healing Word
notes: No effect on undead or constructs.

mech.name: Slow
notes: Action or bonus action, not both; no reactions; one attack. Repeat WIS save at the end of each of its turns.

mech.name: Spirit Guardians
notes: Radiant or necrotic, chosen when cast. Speed halved for enemies in the area.

mech.name: Banishment
notes: The target is banished while the spell lasts.

mech.name: Charm Monster
notes: Advantage on the save if the caster or its allies are fighting it.

mech.name: Conjure Minor Elementals
notes: The caster’s attacks deal an extra 2d8 (+1d8 per slot level above 4) acid, cold, fire or lightning to creatures in the emanation. Difficult terrain for enemies.

mech.name: Conjure Woodland Beings
notes: Once per turn per creature. The caster can Disengage as a bonus action.

mech.name: Giant Insect
notes: Opens Add creature, controlled by the caster.

mech.name: Ice Storm
notes: The area is difficult terrain until the end of the caster’s next turn.

mech.name: Phantasmal Killer
notes: Disadvantage on ability checks and attacks; repeat WIS save at the end of each of its turns, taking the damage again on a failure.

mech.name: Vitriolic Sphere
notes: On a failed save, another 5d4 acid at the end of its next turn.

mech.name: Wall of Fire
notes: The wall’s damaging side, chosen when cast, also burns creatures that end their turn near it.

mech.name: Animate Objects
notes: The animated objects use the caster’s initiative.

mech.name: Conjure Elemental
notes: A restrained target repeats the save at the start of each of its turns, taking 4d8 on a failure.

mech.name: Geas
notes: Takes psychic damage when it acts against the command.

mech.name: Hold Monster
notes: No effect on undead.

mech.name: Summon Dragon
notes: Opens Add creature, controlled by the caster.

mech.name: Telekinesis
notes: The caster can move the restrained creature.

mech.name: Chain Lightning
notes: One target plus three bolts that leap to other targets (one more per slot level above 6).

mech.name: Conjure Fey
notes: Frightened until the start of the caster’s next turn. Bonus action on later turns: teleport the spirit and attack again.

mech.name: Create Undead
notes: Opens Add creature, controlled by the caster.

mech.name: Harm
notes: Can’t reduce the target below 1 hit point.

mech.name: Planar Ally
notes: Opens Add creature, controlled by the caster.

mech.name: Conjure Celestial
notes: Each creature gets healing light (4d12 + modifier) or searing light (the zone).

mech.name: Mind Blank
notes: Also immune to charmed and to mind reading.

mech.name: Power Word Stun
notes: Only if it has 150 hit points or fewer; otherwise its speed is 0 until the start of the next turn.

mech.name: Gate
notes: Opens Add creature, controlled by the caster.

always.question: Does the target have 100 hit points or fewer?
